titulo_es: Konjunktiv I de sein and haben

bloques.titulo: Neutral distinction with sein and haben
texto: In the press and in formal releases, the editor uses **sei** (singular) and **seien** (plural) to attribute statements to a source without compromising its veracity. The verb **sein** is the only one in German that retains distinctive forms in all the people of the Konjunktiv I (**ich sei, er sei, wir seien, sie seien**).

With **haben**, the third person form singular is **er/sie habe**. In plural, as **sie haben** coincides with the indicative, the **hätten** (Konjunktiv II) replacement form is used to maintain the indirect style mark.

filas: Der Sprecher sagt, er sei bereit und habe Zeit.
Die Minister sagen, sie seien optimistisch und hätten Pläne.

frases.de: Die Regierung teilt mit, die Haushaltslage sei stabil.
frases.es: El gobierno comunica que la situación presupuestaria es estable.
frases.en: The government reports that the budgetary situation is stable.
analisis: the budgetary situation would be stable

frases.de: Die Opposition meint aber, die Minister hätten keine Kontrolle.
frases.es: La oposición opina sin embargo que los ministros no tienen control.
frases.en: The opposition is of the opinion, however, that ministers have no control.

frases.de: Der Sprecher betonte, er habe volles Vertrauen in das Kabinett.
frases.es: El portavoz subrayó que tiene plena confianza en el gabinete.
frases.en: The spokesman stressed that he has full confidence in the cabinet.

frases.de: Viele Bürger fragen, ob die Hilfen gesichert seien.
frases.es: Muchos ciudadanos preguntan si las ayudas están aseguradas.
frases.en: Many citizens ask whether the aid is secure.

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct form of Konjunktiv I for «er» with the verb «sein»?

opciones.explicacion: «sei» is the 3rd person singular of the «sein» Konjunktiv I.
It is the present of indicative; it does not mark indirect style.
It is Konjunktiv II, used for unreal hypotheses or situations.

bloques.frase: Der Sprecher erklärt, die wirtschaftliche Lage ___ stabil.

opciones.explicacion: 3rd person singular of the Konjunktiv I of the verb «sein».
It corresponds to the 3rd plural person of indication.
It is Konjunktiv II; it is not the primary neutral form of appointment.

bloques.frase: Der Kanzler sagt, er habe volles Vertrauen in die Minister.

opciones.texto: The Chancellor says he has full confidence in the ministers.
opciones.explicacion: «habe» is Konjunktiv I of «haben» in 3rd person singular.

opciones.texto: The Chancellor regrets that he has lost confidence in the ministers.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase affirms the presence of trust («volles Vertrauen»), not its loss.

opciones.texto: The ministers state that they do not trust the Chancellor's decisions.
opciones.explicacion: The source he speaks is the Chancellor («er habe»), not the ministers.

bloques.pregunta: Why in 3rd plural person is «sie haben» usually replaced by «sie hätten» in indirect style?

opciones.texto: Because «sie haben» is identical to the indicative and would not mark the speech.
opciones.explicacion: The formal coincidence requires a call to the distinctive Konjunktiv II «hätten».

opciones.texto: Because «haben» can only be played in singular in the German press.
opciones.explicacion: «haben» has plural forms in all modes.

opciones.texto: Because «hätten» necessarily indicates that the information is false.
opciones.explicacion: In indirect style, «hätten» functions as a neutral formal substitute.

bloques.frase: Die Abgeordneten erklären, sie ___ neue Vorschläge für den Haushalt.

opciones.explicacion: Konjunktiv II replacement form when «haben» is compared to the indicative.
It is the form of singular («er/sie habe»).
It's 3rd person singular from the sign.

bloques.frase: Viele Bürger fragen, ob die Hilfen gesichert seien.

opciones.texto: Muchos ciudadanos preguntan si las ayudas económicas están garantizadas.
opciones.explicacion: «seien» is the «sein» plural Konjunktiv I in the indirect question.

opciones.texto: The government confirms that the aid has been withdrawn to the citizens.
opciones.explicacion: A withdrawal is not confirmed; the indirect question about its guarantee is raised.

opciones.texto: Los ciudadanos rechazan las ayudas públicas que ofrece el ministerio.
opciones.explicacion: The verb «fragen» raises a question about the continuity of the funds.

bloques.frase: er sei bereit und habe Zeit
bloques.traduccion: that is ready and has time
bloques.explicacion: construction with Konjunktiv I of sein and haren.

intro: We have developed in the pillars of indirect style in the media and official communications: the forms of **sein** and **haben**.
